title: Golden visa & citizenship advisor – latin america
description:
Remote | Report to Athens HQ
Independent Contractor
Uncapped commission - top performers earn €100,000–€200,000+
Who We Are
We believe ambitious people should not be prisoners of their passport.
Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure European residency and citizenship through Greek property investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families - gaining Schengen access, euro-denominated assets, and long-term optionality.
Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. Pass Beyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.
We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from India and South Asia.
The Role
This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals - and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.
You will:
- Introduce Pass Beyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network
- Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks - so they can make an informed decision
- Walk alongside clients from first conversation through to permit in hand
- Build trust through genuine conversation - not scripts or pressure tactics
- Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters
We're not looking for cold-callers or lead-chasers. We're looking for trusted connectors.
Who Our Clients Are
- Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest
- Self-made successes who built wealth through talent and persistence
- Often from environments where institutions have failed them - they're sceptical for good reason
- Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families
- They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured
Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their scepticism, and guides with patience and honesty.
What We're Looking For
Essential:
- Existing relationships with HNWIs in LATAM
- Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve
- Fluent English (written and verbal)
- Comfortable with commission-only compensation
- Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone
Highly Desirable:
- Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services
- Active Linked In presence
Backgrounds that often do well:
- Business owners and entrepreneurs
- Private bankers and wealth managers
- Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients
- Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets
- Community leaders and well-connected professionals
- Successful diaspora professionals in UK, UAE, Singapore, or Europe
What You Get
- Full training and certification on our programmes - no cost to you
- Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens)
- Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory - not generic sales scripts
- CRM system for pipeline management
- Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients
- Direct support from our Athens headquarters - legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you
- As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network
Our Values
Freedom - The right to become who you are capable of becoming - unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.
Integrity - Not a character trait - an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.
Partnership - We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Especialista de seguro garantia
description:
Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!
Somos uma consultoria que une inteligência de riscos e soluções em seguros com o propósito de proteger empresas e pessoas em um mundo que se renova a cada instante. Em nossa trajetória de mais de 45 anos atuando em projetos de alta complexidade, o que nos move são os desafios de nossos clientes e a convicção de que podemos atuar diretamente na transformação de incertezas em oportunidades por meio da criação de soluções sob medida, qualificadas e inovadoras. Acesse: e saiba mais sobre nossa atuação e Nossa Cultura.
Buscamos um/a Especialista de Seguro Garantia com atuação em regime híbrido na Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP, que terá a missão de atuar como referência técnica e relacional em Seguro Garantia, sendo responsável pela análise, estruturação, negociação e viabilização de operações de pequeno, médio e grande porte, assegurando a adequada avaliação de riscos, a sustentabilidade das exposições assumidas, o atendimento qualificado às necessidades dos clientes e o fortalecimento do relacionamento com seguradoras e resseguradoras, contribuindo diretamente para a geração de negócios, a retenção de clientes e a credibilidade da corretora no mercado.

Realizar a análise técnica, comercial e de crédito dos riscos de Seguro Garantia (pequeno, médio e grande porte), incluindo revisão de contratos, processos e obrigações deles decorrentes;

Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais sobre carteira, mercado, exposições e renovações, apoiando a gestão da área e o planejamento estratégico. Para este desafio conosco gostaríamos do seguinte perfil:

Sólidos conhecimentos das modalidades de Seguro Garantia, cláusulas usuais e práticas de mercado;
Vivência na análise de operações estruturadas, como contratos de obras, concessões, infraestrutura, óleo e gás ou energia;
Experiência em negociação e relacionamento com seguradoras e resseguradoras;

Excel em nível intermediário;
Inglês avançado e Espanhol intermediário. Conheça alguns dos benefícios que oferecemos para você e sua família:

Diversas parcerias e convênios que oferecem descontos em serviços e produtos. Localização:

title: Senior software engineer - game technology
description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo.
At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day.
Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure.
WHAT YOU' LL DO
Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs.
Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes.
Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast.
Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.
Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality.
Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming.
Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages.
Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders. WHAT YOU' LL NEED
Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale.
Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments.
Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.
Working proficiency in English. Nice to have
Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development.
Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems.
Experience with AWS infrastructure.
Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products. MORE ABOUT YOU
You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it.
ABOUT WILDLIFE
Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
• Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
• Advanced English (spoken and written),
• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
• Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
• Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• Hybrid working model,
• One day off on your birthday,
• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
• Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our " One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

Experiência Comprovada: Mínimo de 3 (três) anos de experiência sólida e comprovada como Secretário(a) Executivo(a) ou Assistente Administrativo(a) sênior, preferencialmente adquirida em escritórios de advocacia, consultorias ou ambientes corporativos de alta demanda, onde a confidencialidade e a precisão são cruciais.

Comunicação Exímia: Excelente comunicação interpessoal, verbal e escrita, com clareza, concisão e profissionalismo, capaz de interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, clientes de alto perfil e autoridades.

Discrição e Confidencialidade: Essencial para lidar com a natureza sensível das informações jurídicas e pessoais de nossos clientes, aderindo rigorosamente aos princípios da LGPD e ao código de ética profissional, mantendo a mais alta confidencialidade.
Domínio Tecnológico: Proficiência avançada no Pacote Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, Teams), com habilidade para criar documentos, planilhas para relatórios e apresentações impactantes. Familiaridade com ferramentas de videoconferência (Zoom, Google Meet) e sistemas de gestão de processos jurídicos (CRM jurídico) ou plataformas de automação de escritório é um diferencial.
Orientação para Resultados: Foco em otimizar processos, identificar gargalos e contribuir ativamente para a eficiência geral do escritório, buscando sempre a melhoria contínua.
Resiliência e Flexibilidade: Capacidade de se adaptar rapidamente a novas demandas, lidar com situações imprevistas e manter a calma e a produtividade sob pressão.
Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor e precisão na execução de todas as tarefas, desde a revisão minuciosa de documentos até a organização de agendas, garantindo a ausência de erros e a conformidade com os padrões de qualidade. O Que Oferecemos:

About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá'í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.
Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning
High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.
In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.
Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.

title: Médico intensivista (vaga afirmativa)
description:
ESTA VAGA PRIORIZA pessoas negras, indígenas, com deficiência e/ou trans , de acordo com a portaria GM/MS Nº 5.801, de 28 de novembro de 2024.
Olá, somos o Hospital Sírio-Libanês!
Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.
Nos orgulhamos do nosso caráter filantrópico, de um compromisso social genuíno e de sermos uma das melhores instituições de saúde do mundo reconhecida pela revista Newsweek (2023) além de sermos uma empresa TOP Employers , nos destacando entre as melhores instituições do mundo em práticas de Recursos Humanos.
Desta maneira, acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade.
Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!
Sírio-Libanês para todos e todas!
Acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura, por isso respeitamos as individualidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas que acreditam em seu potencial e detêm os requisitos técnicos para executar a função escolhida. Você pode participar dos nossos processos seletivos independentemente de deficiência, raça, etnia, idade, religião, sexo biológico, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, expressão de gênero ou biótipo.
O Sírio-Libanês é uma instituição plural e queremos ser cada vez mais. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade!
O que você vai encontrar neste desafio?
Estamos vivendo em um mundo que está passando por grandes transformações de maneira rápida. Um mundo cada vez mais ágil e digital. Acreditamos na mudança e evolução para sermos cada vez melhores, buscando uma experiência inspiradora.
Por isso, pensando na nossa experiência, queremos ouvir e cuidar cada vez mais das nossas pessoas. Nossa principal missão é incentivar a transformação organizacional por meio da influência, sendo provocador das mudanças que possam elevar a um patamar de inovação e tecnologia para alavancar cada vez mais a competitividade, sem deixar de pensar no nosso potencial, em sermos extraordinários e evoluirmos na jornada do colaborador.
Neste desafio você será responsável por:
Responsável pela assistência médica para os pacientes internados nas unidades críticas de pacientes adultos;
Conhecer os detalhes dos casos, atentando para todas as suas dimensões e traçando o seu plano de cuidado;
Participar da visita multiprofissional à beira leito, registrando o plano de cuidados dos pacientes;
Compartilhar a visão do paciente crítico com as demais equipes assistenciais, buscando participar das decisões e negociar diferentes pontos de vista;
Possuir habilidades de acolhimento e empatia, além de capacidade de resolução de conflitos entre equipe médica/assistencial e familiares;
Exercer proatividade para antever e resolver problemas que envolvam o atendimento ao paciente. Para este desafio você precisará:
Graduação em Medicina;
Residência em Terapia Intensiva ou Título de Especialista em Terapia Intensiva pela AMIB;
Experiência mínima de 2 anos na assistência a pacientes críticos após a conclusão da especialização;
Disponibilidade de horário. Vínculo: CLT
Regime: Horista
Local: São Paulo / SP
Confira os benefícios que temos por aqui:

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards "beauty" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to "Uniting Art and Technology", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior qa analyst - live games
description:
We're looking for a talented and detail-obsessed Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join Wildlife's Quality Assurance team, focused on our Live Games portfolio.
As a Senior QA Analyst, you will be responsible for estimating, planning, and executing test cases across our live titles — evaluating risks and impact, defining quality strategy, and helping the team grow through knowledge sharing. You will communicate testing demands and quality metrics to both developers and other analysts, owning the bridge between QA and engineering.
This role starts with broad coverage across all Wildlife live games, with the longer-term path of migrating into a single high-impact title as ownership deepens. Professional posture, sharp communication, and influence skills are essential - even though this is not a people-management role, you will interact across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.
The right person for this position is curious by nature, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and thrives in a fast-paced live operations context where every build matters.
What You'll Do
Execute manual testing with a meticulous eye across Wildlife's live games portfolio, ensuring every build meets our quality bar before reaching millions of daily players.
Own the end-to-end bug flow: identify, reproduce, write clear bug reports, prioritize based on impact, and decide whether issues go to backlog or require immediate fix.
Write, refine, and continuously optimize test cases - leveraging AI tools (Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate case creation and improve description quality at scale.
Apply AI-assisted build analysis: compare build A vs build B by analyzing code diffs (via Cursor), identifying changed files, and using structured prompts to surface high-risk areas before testing begins.
Hunt corner cases - go beyond the happy path to find edge scenarios that no one else catches, before players do.
Deploy builds on physical devices (i OS and Android), validating real-world behavior, performance, and UX.
Monitor and analyze post-release quality using Firebase, Crashlytics, and internal QA tooling (QA Hub).
Define and evolve quality metrics that engineering and product use to make decisions - not just report them.
Collaborate directly with engineering on debugging, prioritization, and release decisions.
Provide your team with a quality strategy that supports delivery goals and aligns with Wildlife's overall quality strategy.
Advocate for user experience and game quality across product, design, and engineering conversations.
Participate as one of the first analysts on new game projects when needed - helping new dev teams establish quality processes and standards from the ground up. What You'll Need
University degree in computing-related fields (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development) - or equivalent practical experience.
Previous professional experience in software development or game testing, with at least 2 consecutive years in mobile games or high-cadence live operations environments.
Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis.
Solid command of software testing concepts: testability, escape rate, regression, unit, integration, soak, stress, and test automation.
Demonstrated experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, or equivalent crash analytics and monitoring tooling in production environments.
Track record of writing, structuring, and optimizing test cases with method - not just executing scripts written by others.
Proven ability to identify non-obvious corner cases, with concrete examples of critical bugs you found that others missed.
Hands-on experience deploying and validating builds on physical i OS and Android devices.
Active use of AI in your QA workflow - Cursor, Chat GPT, Copilot, or equivalent tools applied to code analysis, test case generation, or debugging.
Clear technical communication - you can speak the developer's language without losing the quality lens. Nice to Have
Experience with live games at scale (millions of DAU).
Track record of creating quality metrics that were adopted by engineering teams.
Familiarity with Unity, C#, or mobile-native stacks.
Experience with mobile test automation (Appium, XCTest, Espresso) - even though this role is primarily manual.
Understanding of Dev Ops tools such as Chef, Ansible, Jenkins, or similar. More About You
You're passionate about games and about software development - and you know how to ensure its quality.
You thrive in agile environments and stimulate that mindset in your team.
You're creative when solving problems and continuously seek improvements in processes and solutions.
You communicate clearly with your team and the broader company to identify issues and align demands.
You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes on the final result.
You are professionally postured and exercise influence even outside of formal leadership roles - knowing how to interact with multiple disciplines and higher job levels with credibility. How We Work
This role is hybrid, with 3 days per week in our Itaim Bibi office (São Paulo). The in-person time is a deliberate accelerator for pair debugging, faster decisions with engineering, and high-bandwidth alignment. The remaining 2 days are remote.
About Wildlife
Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come.

title: Sao paulo/bogota - [hybrid] - l2 soc analyst
description:
About the Company:
As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.
We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.
Role Overview:
As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC's detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization's overall security posture.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Threat Detection & Incident Response
Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews. 2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting
Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks. 3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development
Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape. Required Qualifications and Skills:
A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP).
Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT& CK.
Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense. Working conditions:
Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo) or Colombia (Bogotá)
Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
Fluency in English required

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes.O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

description:

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;

Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;

Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities

Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.

Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.

Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
Automatedhedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development
Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.

Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS

Global banks
EM FX trading firms

FX trading systems

Liquidity aggregation platforms

Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications

Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Motoboy
description:
Descrição da EmpresaBew Store é uma empresa moderna especializada em aparelhos de tecnologia. Com foco na eficiência e na satisfação do cliente, nossa missão é oferecer serviços rápidos e seguros. Valorizamos nossos colaboradores e promovemos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, dinâmico e inclusivo.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management

Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.

Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.

Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automatedhedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development
Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS

Global banks

Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
