Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications
Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue

A. title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;

Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;

Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;

Proficiência em mandarim

Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;

title: Legal writer
description:
U. S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.Responsibilities:Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:
Preparinglegal briefs , includingpersonal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments.
Engaging inextensive drafting , developingpersuasive and well-structured argumentstailored to each case.
Case Strategy & Implementation:
Collaborating withsenior legal specialists and U. S. attorneysto understand and execute case strategy effectively.
Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards.
Legal Research & Analysis:
Conductingin-depth legal researchto identifyrelevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulations
Staying up to date withevolving immigration laws and policy changesto ensure compliance and accuracy.
Be creative in drafting – must have!!!
Document Review
Reviewingclient-provided documentation , identifying missing materials
Ensuring petitions arefully prepared in advancefor mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission.
Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:
Assisting attorneys in case preparation, includinggathering supporting documents, drafting legal arguments, and compiling evidence.
Collaborating withteam members to enhance the accuracy, clarity, and persuasiveness of all written materials.Requirements:·Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.·B. A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.·Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.·Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.·High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.·Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.·Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.Salary depending on experience from $ - $ .

title: Area sales manager (santa catarina state)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:Area Sales ManagerGeneral objective of the role
As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.Reporting lines and interactions
This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager
The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment; you're helping solve problems.“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”Key Responsibilities
Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.Qualifications
Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.
Must-Have
Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.Your Assets
Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and CRM tools.
Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
Team-player

Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Fx trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus onAfrican (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
Automatedhedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development
Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies , such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications
Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:
Descrição
O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.Responsabilidades
Realizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;
Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;
Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;
Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

description:

Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias:Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/PostgresVisão geral da posição
ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataformaQualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria

Curso Técnico em Automação Industrial, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas relacionadas.

title: Coordenador de pesquisa e inovação (farmacotécnico)
description:
Sobre o Inventta ICT
Você já pensou em colocar seu talento a serviço da ciência, tecnologia e inovação no Brasil?
Fundado pela Blau e Bergamo, o Inventta ICT é um Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia dedicado a impulsionar a inovação e a pesquisa científica aplicada ao setor farmacêutico. Nosso foco está no desenvolvimento de medicamentos de alta complexidade e em soluções à saúde de forma segura e sustentável, com integridade, cooperação, qualidade e compromisso com a sustentabilidade, promovemos conexões e desenvolvemos projetos de P& D de alto impacto.
Contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada e atuamos em rede com centros de pesquisa, universidades e empresas. Acreditamos na colaboração como chave para gerar valor e acelerar a inovação em saúde, com forte compromisso com a evolução biotecnológica no país.
Se você quer fazer parte de um ambiente inovador, em crescimento e com propósito, venha para o Inventta ICT. Sua oportunidade de transformar conhecimentos em soluções começa aqui!
Gostou? Inscreva-se e venha para nossas oportunidades!
#vemserinventta
O Dia a Dia Da Oportunidade:
Coordenar e liderar projetos de inovação farmacêutica incremental e radical, abrangendo todas as etapas do desenvolvimento, desde a pesquisa científica, tecnológica e/ou patentária, desenvolvimento em bancada (estudos de viabilidade e screening de protótipos), até o escalonamento e a fabricação de lotes piloto.
Atuar na prospecção, ideação, avaliação e priorização de projetos estratégicos de interesse do Instituto, voltados ao desenvolvimento interno e/ou em parceria com empresas, startups, hospitais, universidades e outras instituições, incluindo a estruturação de overview técnico-científico e definição de escopo.
Coordenar a equipe de analistas e especialistas, fornecendo suporte ao longo de todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de inovações farmacêuticas, orientando a definição de formulações e processos para formas farmacêuticas de liberação imediata e modificada, em diferentes vias de administração.
Atuar em novas tecnologias para plataformas inovadoras de desenvolvimento farmacotécnico, identificando, avaliando e propondo soluções tecnológicas inovadoras e criativas adequadas às necessidades dos projetos, incluindo a captação de fomentos para os projetos.
Conduzir discussões técnicas relativas a inovações incrementais e radicais, assegurando conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais vigentes, bem como atuar em pesquisa translacional e no avanço dos projetos ao longo dos níveis de maturidade tecnológica (TRL – Technology Readiness Levels).
Definir, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho dos projetos e da área, avaliando impacto, eficiência e aderência aos objetivos estratégicos, bem como estruturar fluxos e procedimentos para viabilização das iniciativas de inovação.
Garantir a adequada interface com áreas regulatória, industrial, qualidade, propriedade intelectual e demais áreas correlatas, visando ao cumprimento de prazos, escopo e requisitos regulatórios para registro junto aos órgãos competentes.
Coordenar o planejamento das atividades da equipe, definindo prioridades e cronogramas de trabalho, em alinhamento e validação prévia com a Gerência da área, promovendo senso de urgência e responsabilidade pelo cumprimento de prazos.
Elaborar, revisar e aprovar documentos técnicos para atendimento às Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e Desenvolvimento.
Promover a cultura de inovação no Instituto, orientando pesquisadores e equipe técnica, estimulando o compartilhamento de conhecimentos e experiências profissionais.
Participar de comitês, reuniões técnicas, treinamentos, congressos e seminários, representando a área, acompanhando ou substituindo a Gerência quando designado(a).
Apoiar a Gerência da área nas atividades demandadas, contribuindo para a estruturação do Núcleo de Inovação Tecnológica (NIT) e para o fortalecimento do ecossistema de inovação farmacêutica. O que esperamos que você tenha para concorrer:
Ensino superior completo em Farmácia.
Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização na área.
Indispensável experiência de no mínimo 5 anos em Farmacotécnica/Galênico, com atuação relevante em projetos de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e/ou inovação de produtos farmacêuticos.
Conhecimento atualizado em novas tecnologias, plataformas inovadoras e tendências em desenvolvimento farmacêutico, com capacidade de avaliação crítica e aplicação em projetos.
Vivência em projetos de inovação e novos produtos envolvendo inovação incremental e/ou radical, com interface entre pesquisa científica, desenvolvimento tecnológico e aplicação industrial.
Profissional com perfil inovador, proativo e orientado a resultados, com forte colaboração, comunicação clara e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
Sólida base técnica e científica, com capacidade analítica, visão crítica e aplicação integrada de conhecimentos multidisciplinares.
Organização, tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas em cenários complexos, sob pressão, com foco em qualidade, prazos e conformidade regulatória.
Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, com forte habilidade na elaboração de relatórios técnicos.

title: Accounting manager
description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Analista de orçamento
description:
Sobre a SKR:
A cada ano que passa, a SKR vem trazendo novos significados para o mercado. Hoje, somos uma plataforma completa de desenvolvimento imobiliário e inovação.
Desde que começamos, lá em 1985, o mundo mudou bastante. A forma como as pessoas vivem, como elas se deslocam, como elas usam seu tempo e como interagem umas com as outras. E tudo isso também transformou a nossa forma de enxergar o mercado — deixando de ser padronizado para se tornar cada vez mais personalizado.
Se cada pessoa tem sua individualidade, por que os projetos devem ser iguais? Esse olhar atento para as pessoas é o que transforma a SKR em uma empresa reconhecida por sua inovação.
Desenvolvemos parcerias sólidas, como a Joint Venture com a Incorporadora Cyrela (2007), além de projetos com arquitetos renomados e fundos de investimento como CPPIB e SPX.
Nos orgulhamos da referência que nos tornamos e seguimos com o propósito que definimos desde o início: entregar mais do que unidades — entregar novas formas de viver.
O que buscamos:
Estamos em fase de crescimento e buscamos um(a) Analista de Orçamentos para integrar o nosso time!
Você será responsável por:
Analisar projetos e realizar levantamentos quantitativos com base em projetos em diversas etapas de desenvolvimento;
Elaborar estimativas de custo e orçamentos de obra, desde o lançamento até o orçamento executivo para início de execução;
Analisar composições de custo unitário e curva ABC de insumos e serviços;
Solicitar cotações a fornecedores e equalizar propostas, visando obter o melhor custo-benefício;
Negociar com fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, buscando as melhores condições de preço, qualidade e prazo;
Realizar estudos de custo alternativos ao escopo proposto, identificando oportunidades de redução;
Acompanhar o projeto durante seu desenvolvimento, garantindo entendimento do ciclo e manutenção dos critérios de levantamento quantitativo;
Compor banco dedados com informações de orçamentos e obras, contribuindo para criação e análise de indicadores;
Elaborar documentos auxiliares ao orçamento, como considerações, exclusões, apresentações e demais materiais necessários;
Apoiar a obra quanto a dúvidas e esclarecimentos relacionados aos orçamentos elaborados;
Realizar o lançamento e a gestão do orçamento no sistema (Sienge);
Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega e das metas estabelecidas pela área. Requisitos:
Graduação em Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência mínima de 5 anos com análise de orçamentos e custos na construção civil, preferencialmente em projetos residenciais de baixo/médio padrão;
Capacidade de analisar dados complexos e apresentar informações de forma clara e concisa;

Conhecimento em Sienge (básico) e Auto CAD (intermediário). Diferenciais:
Pós-graduação na área;
Conhecimento emferramentas como Autodesk Design Review, Bim Collab, Sketch Up, Revit ou demais ferramentas BIM. Buscamos alguém com o Perfil Pessoal:

The position will be responsible for coordinating external partners (BPO) in the accounting, tax, and treasury fronts, in addition to ensuring the consistency of numbers and supporting executive leadership with reliable financial reports and analysis. Lead and monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, billing, credit, and collection processes, ensuring operational discipline.
Support executive leadership with clear, organized, and reliable financial reports.
Act as a business partner to the Commercial and Operations areas, supporting product margin analysis, pricing definition, and decision-making.
Ensure consistency and quality of information used in financial planning processes, in interface with the FP& A area.
Structure, review, and improve financial processes, focusing on efficiency, organization, and reliability of information.
Maintain a close relationship with internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment and fluidity of financial processes. Required Skills

Experience: Consolidated in controllership, financial operations, and business partnering at a managerial level.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer

You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.

Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.

Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‐functional GTM operations.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
Hands‐on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‐moving, high‐growth environment.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.
Each of us can help make the world a safer place.
Join us!
The role:
As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.

Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process. Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales. Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management. Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals. Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM. Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.
Qualifications
Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity. Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese. Role-based in São Paulo. Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team. Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating. Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans. Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships. Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance. Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools
Why GROUP-IB?
Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy. Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area. Group-IB. A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? title: Pre-sales consultant - physical ai - brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.
Key Responsibilities
• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.
• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (Li DAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3 D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-Do F pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2 Sim asset creation).
• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.
• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3 D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.
• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.
Required Qualifications
• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.
• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.
• Experience with at least two of: Li DAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3 D reconstruction, or simulation environments.
• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.
Preferred Qualifications
• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.
• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.
• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.
• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).
• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.
• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.
What We Offer
• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.
• Competitive base salary.
• Comprehensive benefits package.
• Flexible remote-first culture.
**At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. Please send us your complete resume in English.

description:

Se você quer servir ao agronegócio sustentável do Brasil, contribuindo para movimentar a riqueza do campo até a mesa das pessoas, candidate-se a uma de nossas oportunidades abertas. Temos operações no Porto de Santos (SP), no Porto de Itaqui (MA) e equipes administrativas em São Paulo, Capital.
O QUE ESTAMOS BUSCANDO?
Profissional com sólida experiência em FP& A, sendo responsável por gerar análises financeiras e projeções que suportem decisões estratégicas, assegurando a qualidade das informações de orçamento e forecast, contribuindo para a otimização de custos, melhoria da performance financeira e orientação de investimentos por meio de análises de viabilidade, risco e retorno.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕ ES
Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis e áreas correlatadas.
Sólida experiência com planejamento e análises financeiras complexas e estratégicas.
Diferencial: conhecimento em SAP e Power BI e experiência com modelagem financeira. INFORMAÇÕ ES ADICIONAIS
Benefícios: Plano de saúde, plano odontológico, vale alimentação e/ou refeição, auxílio academia, auxílio farmácia, seguro de vida, PPR, convênios com instituições de ensino, programas de saúde e bem-estar, entre outros.
Nossa jornada de trabalho é no modelo híbrido, sendo 2 dias em casa e 3 dias no nosso escritório em Santos/SP. Na CLI valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão em todos os nossos processos, não importando perfil ou característica de cor, origem, gênero ou orientação sexual.
